name: Women's median earnings as a share of men's
source: Census Reporter API, ACS 2024 1-year table B20017, Monterey County row; underlying estimates are U.S. Census Bureau ACS
notes: For population 16 years and over with earnings, ACS B20017 reports median earnings for full-time, year-round workers: male $57,171 (B20017_003; MOE $4,095) and female $54,686 (B20017_006; MOE $5,577); ratio = 54,686 ÷ 57,171 × 100 = 95.6525%, displayed to one decimal as 95.7%. This matches the prompt's median earnings ratio for the same work-experience group, although B20017 provides components rather than a single ratio field. The response is the ACS 2024 1-year release, county GEOID 05000US06053. County/DataShare did not yield an accessible current number; official Census API queries returned 503 and direct table URLs were inaccessible. Census Reporter is classified tier 3, and raw Census access remains a limitation.
